name: Artists of Rokeby Summer Camp

sources.note: Session 1 event page: both sessions (July 13-17 and July 20-24, 2026, 9-3), Ages 9-13, 'Tuition: $350/camper or pay what you can', bring lunch, snacks included; contact jahl@rokeby.org, 802.877.3406; footer 4334 Route 7, Ferrisburgh, VT 05456

description_short: A 5-day art, nature and history day camp at Rokeby Museum, a historic farm site in Ferrisburgh, for ages 9 to 13. Campers study the Robinson family's sketches and paintings, take nature walks, birdwatch and track animals, then show their work on the last day. 9:00 am to 3:00 pm; bring lunch, snacks provided.

warnings: This page is an empty event-series listing on a museum website ('0 events found', 'There were no results found'), not a camp page. Nothing on it says Artists of Rokeby is a summer camp or a children's program.

The 2026 series is in the past. The museum says it was 'Open 10 am–5 pm, daily until October 11, 2026' and is now 'open ONLY for special events and programs, school visits, and by appointment.' No 2027 information is given.
The address and phone number belong to Rokeby Museum as a whole, not to any specific program.
unknowns: Whether Artists of Rokeby is a youth or camp program at all, or an adult art event series
Registration URL and when registration opens
